name: Moonlight Geist
oracle_text:
Flying
{3}{W}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.
blocked_sentences: {3}{W}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by this creature this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only: true` option on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and on structs.PermanentShield, read by primitives.damage_permanent / damage_player), so a resolving ability can install a this-turn shield on a permanent that stops only combat damage dealt to and/or by it, leaving noncombat damage (burn, fight, pingers) unprevented
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` takes `dealt: to_and_by` and `duration: this_turn` but has no combat filter, so it would also prevent all noncombat damage to and by the creature -- a strictly better card. The `prevent_damage` static has `combat_only` but is continuous (no 'this turn', cannot be installed by an activated ability) and only stops damage dealt TO what it matches, never damage dealt BY it
